## webAI™ - Software Engineer, CRDT

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/webai/ac849bd2-1fd6-4fef-bbbb-a903d3813214)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- CRDT Software Engineer building secure synchronization and networking systems for webAI’s private, distributed edge AI platform. Working in Rust across peer-to-peer and decentralized environments.
CRDT Software Engineer building private, distributed edge AI infrastructure for webAI
- Tech stack: Cloud, Rust, C++, Go
- Design and implement advanced synchronization and networking systems for reliable AI operations across heterogeneous environments, from edge devices to cloud-isolated systems
- Architect data synchronization frameworks using content-addressable storage, Merkle trees, and CRDTs
- Lead performance tuning, debugging, and optimization of distributed software under resource-constrained and intermittent-connectivity conditions
- Apply security-first design through threat modeling, secure key management, and cryptographic primitives and protocols
- Collaborate with MLOps, Infrastructure, and Security teams to deploy and integrate AI components in restricted or air-gapped systems
- Contribute to cross-functional architectural design discussions and documentation for internal and external stakeholders
- Maintain rigorous testing, observability, and validation practices for system reliability and compliance readiness
- Work with distributed hash tables, content identifiers, gossip protocols, DAGs, overlay networks, and NAT traversal as applicable
- 5-10+ years of experience, depending on leveling, with backend systems languages such as C++, C, Go, or Rust
- Experience with peer-to-peer or decentralized networking frameworks
- CRDT experience is required
- Development will be done in Rust; candidates without Rust experience can get up to speed while working with these systems

### Full Job Description
Summary:
CRDT Software Engineer building secure synchronization and networking systems for webAI’s private, distributed edge AI platform. Working in Rust across peer-to-peer and decentralized environments.
CRDT Software Engineer building private, distributed edge AI infrastructure for webAI
Role description:
• Design and implement advanced synchronization and networking systems for reliable AI operations across heterogeneous environments, from edge devices to cloud-isolated systems
• Architect data synchronization frameworks using content-addressable storage, Merkle trees, and CRDTs
• Lead performance tuning, debugging, and optimization of distributed software under resource-constrained and intermittent-connectivity conditions
• Apply security-first design through threat modeling, secure key management, and cryptographic primitives and protocols
• Collaborate with MLOps, Infrastructure, and Security teams to deploy and integrate AI components in restricted or air-gapped systems
• Contribute to cross-functional architectural design discussions and documentation for internal and external stakeholders
• Maintain rigorous testing, observability, and validation practices for system reliability and compliance readiness
• Work with distributed hash tables, content identifiers, gossip protocols, DAGs, overlay networks, and NAT traversal as applicable
Role requirements:
• 5-10+ years of experience, depending on leveling, with backend systems languages such as C++, C, Go, or Rust
• Experience with peer-to-peer or decentralized networking frameworks
• CRDT experience is required
• Development will be done in Rust; candidates without Rust experience can get up to speed while working with these systems
Benefits:
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package
• 401(k) match (U.S.-based employees only)
• $200/month Health & Wellness stipend
• Continuing Education support
• $500/year Function Health subscription (U.S.-based employees only)
• Free parking for in-office employees

• Parental leave for eligible employees
• Supplemental life insurance
Tech stack:
Cloud, Rust, C++, Go
